CARDS.TITLE: Resource cards
CARDS.DESC:
Each card represents a resource:
🟥Foodlevel 1=>💰
🟨Knowledgelevel 2=>💰💰
🟩Energylevel 3=>💰💰💰
🟦Technologylevel 4=>💰💰💰💰
Each card family has a letter (A, B, C…).
Your wealth = your coins + the value of your cards.

WEALTH.TITLE: The goal
WEALTH.DESC:
The goal: be the richest before the end of the game (coins + card value). To do so:
  • Produce: collect squares of identical cards to produce a card of higher value
  • Buy the cards you are missing from other players with your money
  • Sell the cards you don't need for your squares to get money
How to produce, buy and sell? See the next steps.

ACQUIRE.TITLE: Buy / sell
ACQUIRE.DESC:
To complete your squares, trade with the other players. Two ways to buy (pick the one that suits you best):
  • qr_code_scanner QR code: scan the seller's card (fast)
  • dialpad Digicode: type the number contained in the QR code
To sell, flip your card: the QR code and its digicode are shown to the buyer. Once bought, the card is transferred immediately.

PRODUCTION.TITLE: Produce
PRODUCTION.DESC:
Gather a square: 4 cards with the same letter and the same color (level), then tap Build. You receive:
  • 🎁 1 card of the next level
  • 🟥🟥🟥🟥 4 new cards of the same level
  • ⚡ 1 action token
Missing some cards? Buy them from other players.

ACTIONS.TITLE: Actions
ACTIONS.DESC:
Spend your action tokens to interact with the other players: find who has a card, give one away, steal one, start a conflict, or do some good around you!
You start with 1 token and earn more with each production.

DEATH.TITLE: Death 💀
DEATH.DESC:
Just like in real life, death strikes at random, and nobody escapes it. But don't panic: a new life begins right away 🐣
  • 💀 At the end, the results of your first life are added to your second one
  • 🐣 You are reborn with new cards and 0 coins
That's what keeps the economy going: nothing piles up forever. Keep it in mind, it will matter when comparing the two currencies 😉

JUNE.TITLE: Free money
JUNE.DESC:
Every minute, the Universal Dividend (UD) is shared equally among all living players.
  • Card prices adjust with the UD
  • No bank, no debt
  • Money is created and shared automatically

DEBT.TITLE: Debt money
DEBT.DESC:
You start with 0 coins: you must borrow from the bank to play.
With each loan, you receive coins and must repay the principal + interest within the time limit (5 minutes by default).

REPAYMENT.TITLE: Repay, extend
REPAYMENT.DESC:
When the loan is due, two choices:
  • Repay everything: the loan is settled (you can settle it at any time without waiting for the due date)
  • Pay the interest: the loan is extended, but you still owe the principal
⚠️ If you can't pay the principal → the interest is taken automatically and the loan is extended, but if you can't pay the interest either → 🚨 Payment default: seizure.

SEIZURE.TITLE: Seizure and prison
SEIZURE.DESC:
In case of payment default, the bank seizes your cards (at a 33% discount) and your coins to recover the debt.
If that's not enough: prison for 1 to 5 minutes, out of the game until the sentence ends.
